paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器，温度计和冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中，加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯43.6g(0.2mol)和500ml四氯化碳，再加入0.5g过氧苯甲酸，在室温下滴加39.6g(0.22mol)溴素，滴加时间约50min，滴加完毕，升温回流6h。冷却，用饱和碳酸氢钠中和，分出水层，有机层水洗，浓缩得粗品，粗品用乙酸乙酯洗涤，干燥得固体41.6g，收率70％，熔点75-78℃。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser were charged methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate 43.6 g (0.2 mol) and 500 ml carbon tetrachloride; then 0.5 g of peroxybenzoic acid was added, and at room temperature 39.6 g (0.22 mol) of bromine was added dropwise over about 50 min. After the addition was complete, the temperature was raised and the mixture refluxed for 6 h. It was cooled, neutralised with saturated sodium bicarbonate, the aqueous layer was separated, the organic layer was washed with water and concentrated to give the crude product; the crude product was washed with ethyl acetate and dried to give 41.6 g of solid, yield 70％, melting point 75-78℃.
paragraphs.notes: 过氧苯甲酸 is printed as four characters and reads as peroxybenzoic acid (perbenzoic acid), NOT 过氧化苯甲酰 (benzoyl peroxide); transcribed as printed without correction. Verified by zoom. Arithmetic cross-check (computed by this pass, not printed): 39.6 g of Br2 (FW 159.8) is 0.248 mol, not the 0.22 mol stated; the printed pair does not reconcile. Likewise 43.6 g / 0.2 mol implies FW 218, whereas methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is FW 262.7. Both pairs are transcribed exactly as printed.
As printed there is NO separator between 5.4(s,2H) and 7.70(d,1H) - every other pair is comma-separated. Preserved verbatim, not repaired.

paragraphs.zh: 6、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step heading. Numbered item 6 of Example 1.
Marker present with no text on the line; it introduces the drawn structure that follows (drawing 2).

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器，温度计和冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中，加入2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯55.8g(0.2mol)，三氟乙醇钠28.1g(0.23mol)和100mlTHF溶剂中，室温搅拌16h，然后水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯，加入氢氧化钠9.2g(0.23mol)和水10ml，回流反应4h。蒸除溶剂THF，冷却，残余物加36％HCl酸化，然后用二氯甲烷萃取，水洗，硫酸镁干燥，浓缩得55.6g白色固体，收率92％，熔点154-157℃。NMR(DMSO)：(ppm)3.35(s,3H)，4.25(s,3H)，5.25(s,2H)7.90(d,1H)，8.05(d,1H)。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser were charged methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate 55.8 g (0.2 mol), sodium trifluoroethoxide 28.1 g (0.23 mol) and 100 ml THF solvent; stirred at room temperature for 16 h, then washed with water and concentrated to give ethyl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; sodium hydroxide 9.2 g (0.23 mol) and water 10 ml were added and the mixture refluxed for 4 h. The solvent THF was distilled off, the mixture cooled, the residue acidified with 36％ HCl, then extracted with dichloromethane, washed with water, dried over magnesium sulfate and concentrated to give 55.6 g of a white solid, yield 92％, melting point 154-157℃. NMR (DMSO): (ppm) 3.35 (s, 3H), 4.25 (s, 3H), 5.25 (s, 2H) 7.90 (d, 1H), 8.05 (d, 1H).
paragraphs.notes: Internal inconsistency in the source, transcribed as printed: the substrate charged is the methyl ester (甲酯) and no ethylating agent is present, yet the intermediate produced is named the ethyl ester (乙酯). Also as printed there is no separator between 5.25(s,2H) and 7.90(d,1H). 三氟乙醇钠 is literally 'sodium trifluoroethoxide' (the sodium salt of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol).

paragraphs.zh: 7、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的制备
paragraphs.notes: Step heading. Numbered item 7 of Example 1. 环己烯 uses 己 (hexa), verified by zoom.
Marker present with no text on the line; it introduces the drawn structure that follows (drawing 3).

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器，温度计和冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中，加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸60.4g(0.2mol)，N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(0.05g)和100ml二氯甲烷，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜71.4(0.6mol)，升温回流搅拌6h。蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷100ml，冷却至5℃，滴加入环己二酮24.5g(0.22mol)和三乙胺22.2g(0.22mol)的混合物，滴毕，升至室温搅拌8h。反应物水洗，硫酸镁干燥，浓缩得油状物72.8g，收率92％。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser were charged 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid 60.4 g (0.2 mol), N,N-dimethylformamide (0.05 g) and 100 ml dichloromethane; at room temperature, thionyl chloride 71.4 (0.6 mol) was added dropwise, then the temperature was raised and the mixture stirred at reflux for 6 h. The solvent was distilled off, the residue was taken up in 100 ml dichloromethane, cooled to 5℃, and a mixture of cyclohexanedione 24.5 g (0.22 mol) and triethylamine 22.2 g (0.22 mol) was added dropwise. After the addition was complete, the mixture was warmed to room temperature and stirred for 8 h. The reaction mixture was washed with water, dried over magnesium sulfate and concentrated to give 72.8 g of an oil, yield 92％.
paragraphs.notes: As printed, the thionyl chloride figure 71.4 carries NO mass unit - every other reagent on the line is given in g. Transcribed exactly, unit not supplied. 环己二酮 is printed with no locants (not 环己烷-1,3-二酮), although the drawn structure above the paragraph is the enol ester of cyclohexane-1,3-dione. Arithmetic cross-check computed by this pass: 71.4/0.6 = 119 (SOCl2 FW 118.97, consistent), 24.5/0.22 = 111.4 (cyclohexanedione FW 112.13, consistent), 22.2/0.22 = 100.9 (Et3N FW 101.19, consistent), but 60.4/0.2 = 302 against FW 346.7 for the benzoic acid, which does not reconcile.
Step heading only; the procedure continues on the next page. 环磺草酮 is the Chinese common name for tembotrione.

Two systematic glyph ambiguities affect the whole page and are recorded here rather than guessed away: (1) the serif face used renders lowercase Latin 'l' identically to the digit '1' (compared side by side at 22x: the final character of 'mol' in '0.23mol' is pixel-for-pixel the same glyph as the leading '1' of '1g' and of '100'), so 'mol', 'ml' and 'HCl' are read from chemical context, not from glyph shape.

(2) ASCII punctuation is typeset with full-width advance throughout, so half-width vs full-width cannot be distinguished with certainty for '(' ')' ',' '.' inside numeric and Latin runs. This transcription uses half-width forms inside numeric/Latin runs (43.6g(0.2mol), 3.25(s,3H)) per the prompt's own worked examples, and full-width forms for CJK sentence punctuation (，。：) and for ％ and ℃, which are unambiguously full-width in the scan.
